inputs.label: Raw Sequences
inputs.description: DADA2 sequence table, FASTA file, or DNAStringSet

inputs.label: Match Data
inputs.description: Standardized R data frame already in memory with observation_id, score, and taxonomy columns. Use this ONLY if data is already read into R. Raw BirdNET CSV files = birdnet_detections. Raw image classifier files = image_classifier_output.

inputs.label: Taxon List
inputs.description: Data frame with taxonomy rank columns (e.g. data.frame(family = 'Gobiidae') or data.frame(species = c('Eucyclogobius newberryi', 'Clevelandia ios'))). Column names encode taxonomic rank for GBIF lookups.

inputs.label: Consensus Table
inputs.description: Pre-existing consensus assignments (one row per sample)

inputs.label: Reference Sequences
inputs.description: FASTA + taxonomy table, output of fetch_ncbi_reference_sequences(), fetch_bold_reference_sequences(), read_crabs_output(), or read_reference_fasta()

inputs.label: Occurrence Data
inputs.description: GBIF download, CSV, or other occurrence records with coordinates

inputs.label: BirdNET Detections
inputs.description: Raw BirdNET-Analyzer CSV output files (directory path, single file, or file vector). Contains species, confidence, start/end time per detection clip.

inputs.label: Image Classifier Output
inputs.description: Camera trap image classifier results: Animl CSV, iNaturalist CV per-image JSON files, or Wildlife Insights / SpeciesNet batch predictions JSON.

inputs.label: Local Reference Database
inputs.description: User-supplied sequence database: CRABS internal-format TSV, or a FASTA file with a companion taxonomy TSV (QIIME2 / SILVA / prefix-style).

inputs.label: Reference Image Labels
inputs.description: Ground-truth labels for reference images: data frame with image_path + taxonomy columns (genus, species). Used to build an image likelihood model.

intermediates.label: Reference Matrix (DNA)
intermediates.description: Pairwise distance matrix from DECIPHER alignment of DNA sequences

intermediates.label: Cleaned References
intermediates.description: Reference data with mislabeled sequences removed

intermediates.label: Likelihood Model
intermediates.description: Trained taxa_model_params object from TaxaLikely; works for DNA, acoustic, and image data

intermediates.label: Ecological Context
intermediates.description: Site context (ecoregion, main_habitat, date) from build_context()

intermediates.label: Prior Probabilities
intermediates.description: Spatial priors from TaxaExpect's occurrence-based prior-estimation pipeline (estimate_kernel_priors(), current recommended path)

intermediates.label: Posterior Probabilities
intermediates.description: Bayesian posteriors from compute_posterior() or LLM pipeline

intermediates.label: Site Table
intermediates.description: Per-observation spatial grouping table (observation_id, lat, lon, spatial_group_id, spatial_group_N) from build_site_table() + group_observations_by_bbox()/assign_spatial_group(). Required for the multi-site priors and multi-site posterior-combination paths -- use this ONLY when observations come from more than one distinct site/sampling location that should be modeled separately, not pooled into one grid.

outputs.label: Consensus Taxonomy
outputs.description: One best taxonomic assignment per sample

outputs.label: Reviewed Consensus
outputs.description: Consensus with LLM expert review columns

outputs.label: Reference Gaps
outputs.description: Census of unreferenced species per genus

outputs.label: Prior Map
outputs.description: Spatial prior probabilities as RDS or interactive map

outputs.label: Likelihood Table
outputs.description: Per-hypothesis likelihood estimates saved as RDS, ready for TaxaAssign or standalone analysis

edges.label: BLAST sequences against reference database
edges.description: Read sequences, filter by length/abundance, run BLAST, standardize output, remove redundant higher-rank hits. Optionally screens reference accessions for taxonomic incongruence with independent GenBank evidence (evaluate_reference_accessions()/flag_incongruent_references(), 2026-08-08 audit's recommended pre-training screen).
edges.time_estimate: 10-60 min (depends on BLAST method and number of sequences)

edges.label: Build a multi-site table and group observations spatially
edges.description: Build a per-observation site table (embedded lat/lng, or a separately supplied site_df from join_event_site_metadata()), then assign spatial_group_id by drawing group boundaries interactively (or via assign_spatial_group() when groups are already known from metadata). Only needed when observations span multiple distinct sites that should NOT be pooled into one grid/prior.
edges.time_estimate: 1-15 min (interactive polygon drawing, or seconds if group_col already known)

edges.label: Extract unique taxa from match data
edges.description: Auto-detect rank columns, derive taxon_name and taxon_name_rank using create_taxon_names(), then extract unique names

edges.label: Fetch occurrence records from GBIF
edges.description: Resolve taxon names to GBIF keys, query occurrences within a bounding box, filter for quality, deduplicate
edges.time_estimate: 1-5 min (depends on number of taxa and GBIF response)

edges.label: Fetch occurrence records from GBIF, with geographic-outlier screening
edges.description: Same as the standard GBIF fetch, plus a geographic-outlier check: for species with few local records, fetches that species' global GBIF distribution and flags/removes local records that are outliers against it (e.g. a single mis-georeferenced citizen-science record from the wrong continent). Slower and needs the CoordinateCleaner package -- use this when the study includes citizen-science-heavy sources or unfamiliar taxa where a mis-ID/mis-georeference is a real risk; skip it for a small, well-curated species list.
edges.time_estimate: 3-15 min (extra global GBIF fetch per rare-locally species)

edges.label: Standardize occurrences and assign habitat
edges.description: Rename columns to DwC, stack multiple sources, classify any institution-proximity flags from filter_gbif_quality(), assign habitat via LLM (build_habitat_prompt + parse + assign_habitat_biological), flag spatial inconsistencies

edges.label: Build priors from standardized occurrences, grouped by sampling/detection process (kernel path)
edges.description: Same as std_to_priors_kernel, but computes composition AND the Good-Turing budget WITHIN each sampling_group_col value (estimate_kernel_priors(sampling_group_col=)) instead of pooling every taxon into one shared denominator. Use when your data spans multiple detection PROCESSES with different effort (e.g. one dataset covering fish, birds, AND phytoplankton via different survey methods) -- pooling incomparable sampling effort across groups silently dilutes a detectable taxon's share and inflates barely-sampled groups' singleton counts. This is a DIFFERENT axis than the site_table node (which groups by physical SITE, not by detection method) -- the two can be combined but are independent choices. 2026-09-09: rewritten from the retired GLMM-path wrapper train_biodiversity_model_by_group() (archived, zero real callers) to the kernel-path equivalent -- a single estimate_kernel_priors(sampling_group_col=) call now handles every group at once, no per-group model-fitting loop needed.
edges.time_estimate: seconds to ~1 min (offline; no live network calls unless domestic priors are included)

edges.label: Build priors via site-centered kernel estimation (2026-08-30/31 redesign)
edges.description: A genuinely different estimator from the GLMM/grid-cell paths above, not an add-on step: site-centered distance-kernel weighting (geo x optional-covariate product kernel) directly on standardized occurrence data, with NO gridding/create_sites_from_grid() step at all -- each record is weighted by its own distance from the focal site instead of being binned into a grid cell first. Bandwidth is chosen automatically via leave-one-block-out composition prediction (replaces the GLMM path's AIC formula screening). Recommended over the GLMM/grid paths for a single-site study, or where the grid-cell approach has previously produced boundary-sensitive/alphabetical-tie artifacts. Optionally adds named domestic/commensal-animal and food-species priors, same as the other priors-building edges.
edges.time_estimate: seconds to ~1 min (offline; no live network calls unless domestic priors are included)

edges.label: Infer ecological context via LLM
edges.description: Send taxon names + geographic hint to LLM to infer ecoregion, main_habitat, and date. Returns a context object for downstream use.

edges.label: Fetch reference sequences from NCBI
edges.description: Search NCBI nucleotide by taxon + barcode marker, resolve taxonomy, download FASTA
edges.time_estimate: 5-30 min (depends on number of taxa and NCBI availability)

edges.label: Build pairwise distance matrix
edges.description: Align reference sequences with DECIPHER, compute pairwise distances. Requires Bioconductor packages.

edges.label: Screen and remove mislabeled references
edges.description: Free local corroboration check (does an independent conspecific already in the reference set agree?), then BLAST only what that check can't resolve, then remove accessions flagged for removal
edges.time_estimate: seconds to hours (BLAST only for accessions the free local check can't resolve)

edges.label: Train likelihood model
edges.description: Fit hierarchical Bayesian model: per-species score distributions with Empirical Bayes shrinkage. Outputs taxa_model_params object.

edges.label: Evaluate likelihoods from trained model
edges.description: Apply model to match data: compute H1/H2/H3 likelihoods per sample x taxon. Optionally filter to top hypotheses.

edges.label: Join priors and compute Bayesian posteriors (single site)
edges.description: Match likelihoods to spatial priors by taxon_name + one site (lat, lon, main_habitat), then compute posterior = likelihood * prior (normalized per sample). Use ONLY when every observation comes from the same single site -- if observations span multiple distinct sites, use the multi-site version instead (needs a site_table).

edges.label: Join priors and compute Bayesian posteriors (multi-site)
edges.description: Match likelihoods to per-site priors using the site_table (one row per observation with its own site's lat/lon/spatial_group_id, instead of one shared site for every observation), combine each candidate's per-site priors via combine_multisite_priors() (precision-weighted logit combination -- correctly discounts a low-confidence/sparse-data site rather than a plain average), then compute posteriors. Requires priors to have been generated per-site (see dist_to_priors_multisite).

edges.label: Posterior consensus via LCA
edges.description: Select most probable taxon per sample using cumulative threshold, then refine via empirical Bayes update. Optionally computes group-level occurrence priors (compute_group_priors(), 2026-07-30) so consensus_prior reflects a real group-level sum instead of a candidate-scoped max.

edges.label: Score-based consensus (simplest, no model/priors)
edges.description: Rule-based consensus: minimum score + maximum gap + optional rank thresholds. No training or API calls needed. Auto-creates taxon_name column if missing.

edges.label: LLM-shortcut pipeline (wrapper, recommended for quick results)
edges.description: Single call: builds context, assigns via LLM, computes posteriors, runs consensus. Requires API key. Use when standard defaults are acceptable. Auto-creates taxon_name column if missing.

edges.label: Full Bayesian pipeline (wrapper)
edges.description: Single call: evaluates likelihoods, joins priors, computes posteriors, runs consensus. Requires pre-trained model and priors. Use when standard defaults are acceptable. Auto-creates taxon_name column if missing. IMPORTANT: this wrapper does NOT call combine_multisite_priors() -- if observations span multiple distinct sites, use the manual lik_prior_to_post_multisite path instead (via post_to_consensus), or duplicate per-site candidate rows will reach compute_posterior() uncombined.

edges.label: LLM expert review of assignments
edges.description: Send consensus taxa to LLM for structured review: habitat fit, geographic plausibility, contaminant risk, alternatives

edges.label: Flag contamination and handler artifacts
edges.description: Compare detections against control samples and/or check temporal proximity to handler presence

edges.label: Audit reference database coverage
edges.description: Check which species are missing from the reference (no barcode sequences). Returns a census per genus.

edges.label: Save prior probability table to disk
edges.description: Save priors object as RDS. The archived plot_theta_map_interactive() (GLMM/grid path) was this edge's own interactive-map step until it was archived 2026-09-09 along with the rest of the GLMM chain; the kernel path's own visualizer, plot_theta_surface(), needs the full kernel_fit object (not just the flattened priors table this generic edge has), so it is wired directly inside std_to_priors_kernel.R / dist_to_priors_by_group.R instead of here -- this edge is now save-only.

edges.label: Save likelihood table
edges.description: Save per-hypothesis likelihoods as RDS for downstream TaxaAssign or standalone analysis. Prints summary of hypothesis types and sample coverage.

edges.label: Extract unique taxa from consensus table
edges.description: Pull unique taxon names from an existing consensus assignment table

edges.label: LLM expert review of existing consensus
edges.description: Send pre-existing consensus taxa to LLM for structured review: habitat fit, geographic plausibility, contaminant risk, alternatives

edges.label: Flag contamination and handler artifacts in existing consensus
edges.description: Compare detections against control samples and/or check temporal proximity to handler presence

edges.label: Standardize BirdNET detections to match format
edges.description: Read BirdNET CSV output files, apply confidence threshold, standardize to canonical match_df format with observation_id, score, and taxonomy columns

edges.label: Standardize image classifier output to match format
edges.description: Read Animl, iNaturalist CV, or SpeciesNet output; apply confidence threshold; standardize to canonical match_df format

edges.label: Load local reference database (CRABS or FASTA)
edges.description: Read a user-supplied CRABS internal-format database or a FASTA + taxonomy TSV into reference_df, ready for build_sequence_matrix()

edges.label: Build site-specific reference library (recommended for eDNA)
edges.description: Fetch sequences from NCBI + audit barcode coverage + export FASTA, chained directly (build_site_reference() wrapper archived 2026-09-09, zero real callers). Best when taxa list comes from TaxaExpect. DNA / eDNA only.
